text:
maria-l: FYI customer onboards this week asking for Splunk + S3 export of audit events. They want event-level KMS key id and actor.role exposed. Question: do we need an RBAC change to let them pull their tenant's audit stream, or can we do scoped webhook creds?
shawn-k: scoped webhook creds sounds cleaner. but for S3 export they'll need a dedicated role/arn with PutObject.
anish: +1. Also the schema change (adding kms_key_id and actor.role) needs validation docs. we should publish a compatibility matrix (old clients vs new fields).
leah: is kms_key_id sensitive? customers might be surprised. do we redact anything?
maria-l: kms_key_id is just an identifier, not secret, but we should confirm with privacy/legal. we don't log KMS CMK material.
security-bot: Reminder: file S-4182 created for audit schema v2. Assigned: @anish.
anish: quick sketch of sample event we'll publish: ```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F7...",
  "ts": "2025-11-15T16:17:12Z",
  "actor": {"id":"user_123","role":"platform-admin"},
  "action": "model.deploy",
  "resource": {"type":"deployment","id":"dep-45"},
  "outcome": "success",
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01",
  "delivery": {"method":"s3","bucket":"rw-audit-12345","path":"2025/11/15/evt_01F7.json"}
} ```
maria-l: perfect. need to add version field and schema_url too so integrators can auto-validate.
shawn-k: agree. also add a boolean field `redacted` for any fields we strip during export.
leah: onboarding notes: for Splunk HEC we surface the schema_url and provide a small transform config. for S3 we include manifest + gzipped events per hour.
anish: validation strategy: 1) schema registry (internal S3 url) with JSON Schema v7, 2) CI job that validates samples, 3) contract tests customers can run.
maria-l: who owns the webhook token rotation? ops or security?
shawn-k: ops can rotate, but token provisioning must be scoped by tenant and logged as audit event. RBAC: we need a new permission `audit:export:read` to grant external export access.
leah: that permission will appear in the tenant admin role in the console. update RBAC docs.
security-bot: Note: vulnerability triage - no direct vuln in adding non-secret fields, but ensure we don't leak internal principal IDs.
anish: action items: (1) publish JSON Schema + schema_url (I), (2) PR for event versioning + new fields in runtime (SRE/eng-runtime), (3) onboarding guide for Splunk/S3 (docs).
maria-l: I'll create a customer-facing checklist: required IAM, sample CloudFormation for S3 role, Splunk HEC config, and example curl for webhook registration.
shawn-k: sample webhook registration API: ```http
POST /v1/audit/exports
{
  "method":"webhook",
  "url":"https://customer.example.com/hec",
  "credentials":{"type":"bearer","token":"<rotating-token>"},
  "events":["model.deploy","model.delete","auth.login"],
  "format":"jsonschema-v2"
} ```
leah: testing plan: smoke ingest to dev-splunk, end-to-end S3 put with kms encryption, and run contract tests.
maria-l: timeline? customer onboarding Wed. can we get schema + sample by EOD tomorrow?
anish: I can publish schema today and open PR for docs tomorrow morning.
shawn-k: runtime changes staged. will post PR link.
deploy-bot: audit-schema-v2 merged to staging by @anish (PR #2347) — deploy queued.
maria-l: awesome. last: add monitoring alert if delivery failures exceed 5/min for a tenant and auto-fallback to internal retention only.
leah: noted. will add to console routes and create alerting runbook.
maria-l: thanks everyone — ping me when the sample manifest and CFN template are ready. :thumbsup:
